$meta.name: DormCheck Design Tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth for DormCheck design tokens. CODE IS CANONICAL: this file is authored by hand to match the live implementation (tailwind.config.ts + src/index.css), then projected outward to Tailwind (build) and Figma (scripts/sync-figma-tokens.mjs -> collection 'DormCheck Tokens', VariableCollectionId:2:3). Edit a value HERE, then run the build + the Figma sync so web, iOS, and Figma all move together.
notes: Colors that are themed at runtime carry an `hsl` triplet (space-separated, no commas) that mirrors the CSS custom properties in src/index.css. Tailwind consumes those via hsl(var(--token)); the literal `hex` is the light-theme / brand value and is what Figma receives.
`color.background` is a deliberate cool off-white (NOT pure white) so white cards read as elevated - see src/index.css. The card/popover surface is the true #FFFFFF.

brand.description: Primary brand green. Buttons, active states, accents.

brand-light.description: Lighter brand green, = malachite-500. Derived one step up the malachite ramp from brand (#03C03C). Was #34A853 until 2026-08-02, which was byte-identical to Google brand green and, despite the name, DARKER than brand.

muted-foreground.description: Secondary/subtle text. WCAG AA: 4.7:1 on background, 5.1:1 on surface.

muted.description: Muted surface / subtle fill - green-tinted neutral.

background.description: Page background - pure white (native app + web); cards read as elevated via their shadow/border, not a background tint.

surface.description: Card / popover / sheet surface - true white.

destructive.description: Errors, destructive actions. Darkened off the stock #EF4444 so white text on a solid destructive fill clears AA; this is the light-mode value shipped in src/index.css (dark mode lightens to 0 72% 51%).

stone-50.description: Warm-neutral 50 - lightest. DormCheck warm gray (Warm Neutral Redesign 2026-07-20): the text/border neutral, replacing Tailwind's built-in cool `slate`. Derived from Tailwind stone's lightness curve with the hue nudged off stone's brown-lean (~25 deg) to a cleaner true warm gray (~40 deg) at low saturation - reads warm next to malachite on the green-tinted --page without going beige/olive. Do NOT revert to canonical Tailwind stone values.

stone-400.description: Warm-neutral 400 - decorative/placeholder only (2.6:1, sub-AA for text, same class as the slate-400 it replaces). Darkened off stock stone-400 (#a8a29e); keep this value, do not revert.

stone-500.description: Warm-neutral 500 - primary muted/secondary text. Deliberately DARKER than Tailwind stone-500 (#78716c): stock stone-500 is only 4.33:1 on the green-tinted --page (below the 4.5 AA floor); this value is 5.15:1 on white and 4.85:1 on --page. Do NOT revert to canonical stone-500 - it fails AA on the dashboard canvas.

stone-600.description: Warm-neutral 600 - body text. Darkened slightly off stock stone-600 to keep the ramp even after the stone-500 AA correction; keep this value.

stone-900.description: Warm-neutral 900 - headings/near-black (was text-slate-900, the most common neutral).

stone-950.description: Warm-neutral 950 - deepest. Warm near-black anchor for --gradient-brand (replaces cool slate-900 #0f172a).

radius.$comment: Phase 1.8 (2026-07-20): the raw scale is now MONOTONIC — xl was Tailwind's untouched 12px default, SMALLER than lg (var(--radius)=16px), so reaching for a rounder corner (xl) silently flattened it; xl is now 18px (between lg 16 and 2xl 20). The FOUR SEMANTIC TIERS below are the sanctioned decision surface — pick a corner by what the element IS, not by size: editorial 24 (large surfaces that read as a page, not a control — hero/mockup/statement blocks), card 16 (the default container — listing cards, dashboard tiles, sheets), control 12 (buttons, inputs, selects, small interactive things), pill 9999 (badges, chips, avatars, toggles — the only legitimate full-round). editorial/card/control are visibly distinct (24/16/12).

spacing.$comment: Keyed by pixel value to match the Figma 'spacing/<px>' variable naming. Scale: 4 8 12 16 24 32 48.

typography.scaleNote: The documented step ramp for LITERAL font sizes (Tailwind arbitrary values, text-[Npx]). Tailwind's own named steps (text-sm/base/lg/…) and the clamp-driven marketing sizes in src/components/marketing/landing/tokens.ts (TYPE.display/h2/h3/statement, resolved through --type-* in src/index.css) are separate systems and unaffected. Any text-[Npx] whose N is not a step below is DRIFT: RULE 7 in scripts/check-colors.mjs grandfathers today's per-file count in scripts/type-baseline.json and fails on growth. Shrink the baseline, never raise it. Adding a step here is a design-system change — mirror it into DESIGN.md's typography block in the same pass, or the impeccable design hook keeps flagging the value as undocumented.

9.use: nano — numeric badges and dense counters only

10.use: micro — uppercase tracking labels, pill counters

11.use: micro — tab and chip labels, table meta

13.use: caption — eyebrows, section meta, small links

15.use: body-sm — list rows, secondary body, dense UI copy

17.use: body — marketing body and hero lede

44.use: title-2xl — the closing-CTA headline, one line at desktop
